parameters.query:
=SELECT 
  c.id,
  c.contract_number,
  c.status,
  c.start_date,
  c.total_amount,
  c.signed_at,
  c.created_at,
  c.updated_at,
  u.id as creator_id,
  u.email as creator_email,
  u.full_name as creator_name,
  u.username as creator_username,
  t.id as translator_id,
  t.full_name as translator_name,
  t.email as translator_email,
  w.name as work_name,
  w.id as work_id,
  CASE 
    WHEN c.signed_at IS NOT NULL AND c.signed_at + INTERVAL '1 year' < CURRENT_DATE THEN 'expired'
    WHEN c.signed_at IS NOT NULL AND c.signed_at + INTERVAL '1 year' <= CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '30 days' THEN 'expiring_30_days'
    WHEN c.signed_at IS NOT NULL AND c.signed_at + INTERVAL '1 year' <= CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '7 days' THEN 'expiring_7_days'
    WHEN c.signed_at IS NULL AND c.start_date + INTERVAL '1 year' < CURRENT_DATE THEN 'unsigned_expired'
    WHEN c.signed_at IS NULL AND c.start_date + INTERVAL '1 year' <= CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '30 days' THEN 'unsigned_expiring_30_days'
    WHEN c.signed_at IS NULL AND c.start_date + INTERVAL '1 year' <= CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '7 days' THEN 'unsigned_expiring_7_days'
    ELSE NULL
  END as expiry_status,
  COALESCE(c.signed_at::date, c.start_date) + INTERVAL '1 year' as expiry_date
FROM translation_contracts c
LEFT JOIN users u ON c.created_by_id = u.id
LEFT JOIN translators t ON c.translator_id = t.id
LEFT JOIN translation_works w ON c.work_id = w.id
WHERE c.status IN ('signed', 'active', 'pending')
  AND (
    (c.signed_at IS NOT NULL AND c.signed_at + INTERVAL '1 year' <= CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '30 days')
    OR (c.signed_at IS NULL AND c.start_date + INTERVAL '1 year' <= CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '30 days')
  )
ORDER BY expiry_date ASC

=SELECT log_workflow_execution('{{ $node["Format Contract Expiry Data"].json.workflow_name }}', '{{ $node["Format Contract Expiry Data"].json.execution_id }}', 'Send Expiry Notifications', 'notification', 'success', '{{ JSON.stringify({total_contracts: $node["Format Contract Expiry Data"].json.totalContracts, expired: $node["Format Contract Expiry Data"].json.expiredCount, expiring_7_days: $node["Format Contract Expiry Data"].json.expiring7DaysCount}) }}'::jsonb, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL) as log_id
